title: Grothendieck derived Brown right adjoint
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], D(A) its ordinary unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and T a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category]. An exact functor F : D(A) → T that preserves arbitrary set-indexed coproducts admits a right adjoint. Coproducts and Hom sets are understood in a common indexing universe; no compact generation of D(A), boundedness, or geometric hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: for each target object Y, the additive functor H(W) = Hom(F(W), Y) is cohomological by exactness and takes coproducts to products. The Grothendieck Brown argument represents H as follows. Present the abelian category by the Gabriel-Popescu exact localization L from modules over a ring R. Its derived right adjoint RG is fully faithful and L RG is the identity. The functor H L is represented by a module complex E, by Brown representability for the compact generator R. In the triangle M → E → RG(L(E)) → M[1], L(M) = 0, so Hom(M, E) = H(L(M)) = 0. Thus E → RG(L(E)) is a split monomorphism. Via the localization adjunction, H is consequently a natural direct summand of Hom(-, L(E)). The derived category is idempotent complete, so this summand is represented. Finally Yoneda assembles the representing objects for all Y into a functor and the natural representing bijections give the right adjunction. This is the argument of Tags 0F5X and 0F5Y; no compact-generation assertion for D(A) is used.

theorem grothendieckDerived_hasRightAdjoint
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    {D : Type uD} [Category.{vD} D] [HasZeroObject D] [HasShift D ℤ]
    [Preadditive D]
    [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor D n).Additive]
    [Pretriangulated D] [IsTriangulated D]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vD} D]
    (F : DerivedCategory A ⥤ D) [F.CommShift ℤ] [F.IsTriangulated]
    [HasCoproducts.{max w vA vD} (DerivedCategory A)]
    (hF : ∀ I : Type (max w vA vD),
      PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) F) :
    F.IsLeftAdjoint
